The Birdland Jazz Club was a popular nightclub in Harlem at the corner of 52nd Street and Broadway. It operated from January 1945 until its closure on September 30, 1959. It featured many of the greatest names in jazz music, including Charlie Parker, Ella Fitzgerald, Louis Armstrong, and Billie Holiday.
